slides.texte_overlay:
hobbies that will make you
dangerously confident

no phone at the table

for one week, keep your phone in your pocket at every meal with other people. being fully present is so rare now that people notice it, and they remember how you made them feel.

a week without posting

go one week without posting anything online, then notice how much of your day you were narrating for others. confident people don't need an audience to enjoy the moment.

hiding the likes

hide the like counts on your apps for a month. when you stop scoring your life in numbers, you start judging your days by how they actually felt, which is the only score that matters.

five minute fascinations

every day, spend 5 minutes on something that fascinates you instead of your feed: a planet, an ancient myth, a famous painting. a full mind needs much less approval from others.

unfollowing comparison

unfollow 10 accounts that make you feel behind, today. confidence is hard to build when you start every morning comparing yourself to strangers' best moments.
